description: Create a company (B2B account). The company name must be unique in the workspace. Enforces the workspace plan limit; the result echoes the operating workspace. Use search_companies first to avoid creating a duplicate.

name.description: The company name. Required and unique within the workspace.

anyOf.description: User id of the workspace member who owns this company. Optional.

ownerId.description: User id of the workspace member who owns this company. Optional.

size.description: Company size band. Optional. One of: solo, small, medium, large, enterprise.

status.description: Relationship status. Optional. One of: prospect, active, inactive.

name: create_company
title: Create company
